title: Passing an immutable value as an interface with mutable fields fails
notes: A mut interface field grants mutation through the parameter. With the const-literal Object.freeze removed (deka#590 step 2), the call site is the guard: the checker rejects passing an immutable receiver to an interface with mut fields.
expectedDiagnosticContains: cannot pass an immutable value as interface `MutableNamed` with mutable fields
